examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to call for, to summon (a taxi, driver, police, doctor)

examples.text: Ты же не помнишь ничего. Ты вызвал трезвого водителя!
examples.trans: You don't remember anything, after all. You called a sober driver!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: Звать на помощь = to call for help.
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
The commission will inspect the kitchen.

meanings.note: From Latin 'inspector' (observer, overseer, from 'inspicere', to look into).

examples.text: Инспекторы ищут нарушения только ради денег.
examples.trans: Inspectors look for violations only for money.
The inspector is checking the kitchen.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

meanings.note: вот это неожиданно = now that is unexpected

examples.text: Вот это неожиданно! Ягодка вы моя!
examples.trans: Now that is unexpected! You little berry of mine!

examples.text: Это неожиданно, но ваш торт не такой плохой.
examples.trans: This is unexpected, but your cake isn't so bad.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
We mustn't overfeed you right now.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

examples.text: Да, я наведу здесь железный порядок.
examples.trans: Yes, I'll establish iron order here.
Bring him tomorrow to the hospital.
The father brought his son to the doctor.
You will bring the child in the morning.
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: очень приятно = pleased to meet you

examples.text: Очень приятно. А в чём дело?
examples.trans: Pleased to meet you. So what's the matter?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: short for скорая помощь; declines like an adjective

examples.text: Тут кнопки вызова: скорая, полиция и мы.
examples.trans: Here are the call buttons: ambulance, police, and us.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Всё, хорошо, я тебя выпущу! Только собаку не трогай!
examples.trans: All right, fine, I'll let you out! Just don't touch the dog!

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Уважаемый ветеран, перед вами внук предателя!
examples.trans: Esteemed veteran, before you is the grandson of a traitor!

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович испытывает к вам чувства.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich has feelings for you.

examples.text: Ты же знаешь мои настоящие чувства.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
